     401             :   // Constraints on the internal representation:
     402             :   //
     403             :   // - Should represent positive and small negative ints
     404             :   // - No conversion necessary for operations on ints
     405             :   // - Must represent valid 64-bit pointers
     406             :   // - Is symbolic test should be FAST (two arithmetic instructions is too
     407             :   // much).
     408             :   //   This code being a hotpath is based on Strobelight profiles of
     409             :   //   is_heap_allocated().  FB only: https://fburl.com/strobelight/5l50ncxd
     410             :   //   (you will need to change the time window).
     411             :   //
     412             :   // So, the scheme is to reserve large negative numbers (assuming
     413             :   // two's complement):
     414             :   //
     415             :   // - 0b0.... means we are a positive int
     416             :   // - 0b11... means we are a small negative int
     417             :   // - 0b10... means we are are a pointer. This means that
     418             :   //           [-2^63, -2^62-1] are not representable as ints.
     419             :   //           We don't actually need all of this space as on x86_64
     420             :   //           as the top 16bits aren't used for anything
